text:
Predicates:
Cost(greTest, 205) ::: It costs US $205 to take the GRE test.
ProvidesFinancialAid(ets, x) ::: ETS provides financial aid to x.
Applicant(x, greTest) ::: x is a GRE applicant.
ProvesEconomicHardship(x) ::: x proves economic hardship.
EconomicHardship(x) ::: x has economic hardship.
DifficultyCausedBy(x, y) ::: x is difficulty caused by y.
TooLittleMoney(x) ::: x has too little money.
TooFewResources(x) ::: x has too few resources.
LivesInSingleParentFamily(tom) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
DadOutOfWorkMoreThanYear(tom) ::: Tom's dad has been out of work for more than a year.
Premises:
Cost(greTest, 205) ::: It costs US $205 to take the GRE test.
∀x ((Applicant(x, greTest) ∧ ProvesEconomicHardship(x)) → ProvidesFinancialAid(ets, x)) ::: ETS provides financial aid to those GRE applicants who prove economic hardship.
∀x (EconomicHardship(x) ↔ DifficultyCausedBy(x, TooLittleMoney(x) ∨ TooFewResources(x))) ::: Economic hardship refers to difficulty caused by having too little money or too few resources.
LivesInSingleParentFamily(tom) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
DadOutOfWorkMoreThanYear(tom) ::: His dad has been out of work for more than a year.
Conclusion:
ProvidesFinancialAid(ets, tom) ::: Tom can apply for financial aid from ETS to take the GRE test.
